candidate_construction_procedure: Start from every current eligible post-exclusion broker identity in the persisted current feasibility authority.
Use only outcome-blind broker-native feasibility, asset/product, schedule/session, data-readiness and capital-efficiency metadata.
Assign peer-candidate cohorts without consulting any previously observed strategy return, p-value, support flag or economic result.
Preserve all identities in the index; do not compress cohorts to structural representatives and do not choose observed winners.
Flag rather than fabricate missing cohort metadata or aligned history.
Do not compute the retired Epoch37 breadth-conditioned continuation outcome or any new strategy outcome.
decision.hypothesis: No strategy-return hypothesis is evaluated in this action. The prospective methodological hypothesis is that cross-sectional research requires explicitly defined peer-candidate cohorts and aligned-history eligibility before any pooled or ranking estimand is opened.
decision.implementation_scope: Implement a deterministic, non-economic cross-sectional peer-cohort discovery builder and tests. Read the full current 1576 eligible post-exclusion broker frontier and current outcome-blind feature authorities; retain every eligible identity rather than one representative per structural signature; assign prospective peer-candidate cohorts using only current broker-native asset class, product type, market/session-region or schedule-overlap metadata that are actually present in authority, feasibility, minimum executable volume, directional feasibility, data availability and capital-efficiency/friction proxies. The output must state that cohort membership is a candidate peer-coherence prior rather than behavioral/economic equivalence, report cohort breadth and acquisition readiness, require aligned history before cross-symbol inference, and open no strategy outcome, economics, protected forward evidence or V2 attempt.
decision.novelty_boundary: Do not reauthorize, rerun, retune or evaluate epoch37_breadth_conditioned_trend. This action only constructs the prerequisite mechanism-specific discovery universe and acquisition-readiness map under the post-Epoch37 methodology authority.

required_outputs: power-design prerequisites for any later pooled or portfolio-level inference

universe_methodology.peer_coherence_basis: Same asset-class/product-type market cohort with materially overlapping executable sessions or session regions; this is only a prospective peer-candidate prior and must not be treated as behavioral equivalence until aligned-history structural evidence supports the intended estimand.
universe_methodology.selection_law: Retain the complete current eligible post-exclusion frontier; partition identities prospectively into peer-candidate cohorts using only available outcome-blind market-structure and schedule metadata. Never select one representative as an economic substitute for its cohort and never filter by observed strategy outcome.

next_research_state.implementation_task_scope: Build and validate the deterministic outcome-blind full-frontier cross-sectional peer-cohort index and readiness report defined by the accepted proposal. Do not evaluate any price/strategy outcome.

objective.goal: Materialize an outcome-blind, peer-coherent CROSS_SECTIONAL_RANKING discovery universe from the full current feasible Pepperstone frontier before any new cross-sectional strategy outcome is evaluated.
objective.information_gain_rationale: Epoch37 was retired pre-outcome because the 41 broker-topology representatives were not a valid peer population. The highest-information legal next action is therefore to remove that prerequisite failure at full broker breadth: partition all currently eligible symbols into prospectively defined peer-candidate cohorts using only broker, schedule, feasibility and capital-efficiency metadata, preserve every eligible symbol, and explicitly identify aligned-history requirements. This does not repeat the retired breadth-conditioned-trend hypothesis and does not open economics.
